text: For a flag, call `cmd.RegisterFlagCompletionFunc("flag-name", func(cmd *Command, args []string, toComplete string) ([]string, ShellCompDirective) { ... })` and return candidate strings plus a completion directive. The required callback signature is shown in `completions.go:133-134`; registrations are stored per `*pflag.Flag` (`completions.go:36`).
